stemMd: A solid is made from unit cubes at all integer grid cells with x = 0, 1, 2 and y = 0, with column heights 1, 3, 2 respectively. Looking along y, what is the upper outline from left to right? In the view, increasing x runs from left to right.
explanationMd: The viewing direction removes y-depth while retaining x and z. There is one depth row, so each visible x-column has exactly its stated height. The resulting stepped elevation is one, three, two.

distractorRationale.e: The outline does not fill all columns to the maximum height.
distractorRationale.c: This sorts heights instead of preserving position.
distractorRationale.a: The x positions remain distinct in this view.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses the specified left-to-right x direction.
